WITH matched AS (
  SELECT o.mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(net_fee_rate) AS benchmark_rate
  FROM matched
), pair_averages AS (
  SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_fee_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY mktnote
), above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT p.avg_net_fee_rate, p.avg_net_fee_rate - b.benchmark_rate AS excess
  FROM pair_averages AS p
  CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
  WHERE p.avg_net_fee_rate > b.benchmark_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS average_pair_net_fee_rate,
       AVG(excess) AS average_excess_over_benchmark
FROM above_benchmark;
